claim_verdicts.C1_small_fixed_world_TRAIN_enrichment: yes, within the specified local MODEL_VALID quality gate only
claim_verdicts.C2_local_coupled_pose_loss_reduces_repai: yes for this matched run; generalization and reproducibility remain partial

what_results_support: 48/48 distinct fixed-target TRAIN labels passed model validation across 8 existing goals from 5 families; 4 preselected labels passed actual 67-channel torque execution and replay; 44 remain MODEL_VALID. TRAIN grows 208 to 256, with 30 families unchanged and added-obstacle rows 3 to 21.

Matched goal-loss versus v-only comparison supports a useful local training-loss effect: total coupled queries 2250 to 1735 (-22.89%), candidate wall time 133.1591 to 105.0333 seconds (-21.12%), repair queries 2139 to 1625 (-24.03%). Query totals improved on all 10 tasks.

All five methods achieved 50/50 candidate eligibility and 10/10 selected execution/replay success. Goal-loss Diffusion beat strong spline in observed total queries (-12.24%) and candidate time (-10.13%) at those equal observed success counts.
Goal-loss reduced pre-repair median position error from 68.74 to 34.16 mm, but no learned method had a raw pose-pass candidate.
what_results_dont_support: Diffusion superiority over BOTH strong spline and learned mean is not supported: mean uses 1710 queries and 103.7063 seconds versus 1735 and 105.0333 for goal-loss Diffusion (+1.46% queries, +1.28% time). No extra executed success exists. The predefined advantage gate fails.
48 new rows do not establish new task-family coverage, distinct homotopy classes, useful output multimodality, broad execution certification, or production-scale expansion.
All methods' final success depends on a shared nonlinear projector and adaptive validator; it is not proof of raw diffusion feasibility or learned physical constraint satisfaction.

The frozen-old to augmented-v-only comparison is not an isolated data-only ablation: refitted codec, normalization/center, training membership and per-row exposure change. Initial seed and weights do NOT differ.
One training initialization and reused exploratory VAL tasks do not establish reproducibility, population noninferiority, independent-family generalization, or final TEST performance.
No net end-to-end cost advantage including the offline sensitivity/data investment, and no advantage in independently defined diversity/coverage/trajectory quality, has been established.
missing_evidence: Independent frozen development families, multiple training seeds and at least three prespecified sampling-seed groups, repeated/interleaved timing, paired task/family-level uncertainty and explicit success noninferiority margins.
A controlled comparison of useful stochastic residuals versus matched learned mean and residual attenuation; report target error, repair cost, accepted mode diversity, reverse wins and all failures.
Full frozen rollout of production-stage expansion with actual qualified arrays, stratified execution evidence, provenance, recovery and training/reevaluation.
Broader surrogate accuracy at actual denoising displacements and added trajectories; current checks are local around one anchor per exact TRAIN task.
suggested_claim_revision: On ten reused exploratory VAL tasks, adding a TRAIN-only local coupled-pose error regularizer to otherwise matched diffusion training reduced repair queries and online candidate time while retaining observed execution success. A small fixed-world TRAIN enrichment met its local model-validation and preselected execution gates. The learned mean remains the strongest aggregate cost baseline, and reproducible Diffusion superiority plus actual production expansion remain uncompleted objectives.
next_experiments_needed: First run a bounded TRAIN-only mechanism study of goal-loss diffusion versus the same conditional mean with residual amplitude 0, attenuated residual, and full residual. Measure actual pre-repair goal displacement, final valid diversity and repair burden, with identical projector/gates and all physics calls charged. Freeze the selected setting using TRAIN only. This directly tests whether the current benefit is mainly suppression of harmful noise.

If useful diversity is lost or the mean remains dominant, test a goal-preserving residual/within-denoising correction using the local surrogate, with nonlinear rechecks and strictly charged calls; add obstacle conditioning only as a separately controlled factor, not a simultaneous unidentifiable change.

Freeze a fresh bounded confirmation protocol with unchanged strong spline, matched mean, v-only, goal-loss and the selected next method; retain old frozen model as reference. Use independent development families, multiple training seeds and at least three sampling-seed groups, interleaved repeated timing, equal budgets, paired task-level estimates and predeclared effects. Do not weaken the existing exploratory gate retroactively.

After a reproducible advantage is established, execute the separately authorized staged approximately 1k to 10k to 100k qualified-data route with real generation, lineage and failures, stratified torque execution/replay and actual retraining. Until then, keep the full objective active.
confidence_detail: High confidence in arithmetic, observed local C2 benefit and failure of the present advantage gate; medium confidence overall because review is bounded/read-only, validation tasks are reused, and broad claims lack independent replication.
provisional_label: provisional — no paper claim audit available
routing_action: supplement and mechanism-focused method refinement; do not confirm full goal or route to confirmed superiority claims
code_audit_scope_concerns: Reviewed named evidence hashes (all 7 match), raw candidate aggregate costs, training metadata and objective/sensitivity/report/audit source; did not rerun physics, training or the full independent audit.

Prompt correction: old latent and both new models use seed 20261081 and identical initial_weight_hash b3caf91eeb0b25197a5c10f9aaee413a24fa46f3066846680b921affa39e86ab. Preserve prompt as provenance but do not repeat its different-seed assertion.

Loss is a linearized pose-change penalty on denoised coefficient error using 34 selected directions mapped to 119 coefficients. It is neither full exact physical loss nor a validator. One reused anchor per task need not represent large denoising displacements or all six added variants.

Stored omitted-temporal-direction relative error over 168 anchors averages 0.1562%, maximum 0.6991%, but checks use only one small random displacement per anchor; this is reassuring local evidence, not global certification.
MODEL_VALID raw record explicitly reports reference_torque_feasibility NOT_EVALUATED and continuous_time_certified false. Keep that scope distinct from the selected actual execution/replay records.
RNG hashes are sampled every 100 updates; source determinism plus matching init/data/counts supports the paired-loss design, but this review did not independently replay training.
posthoc_multiobjective_note: Saved-trajectory diagnostics show lower goal-loss median path/effort/acceleration integral than mean, but spline remains better on all three; goal-loss has lower median hold-position error than both. These are posthoc metrics on goal-error-selected trajectories, motivate preregistered multiobjective analysis, and do not alter the failed advantage gate. Supplemental artifact is outside the original seven-input hash manifest.
